prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. DARKLIGHT REQUIEM Punhos da Ruína WALKING CYCLES, correcting the repeated-forward-leg problem.
Draw EIGHT COMPLETE full-body sprites: ROW1 four REQUIEM walking phases, ROW2 four ROCK walking phases, ALL NORMAL brown-hair form, moving southeast toward IMAGE LOWER RIGHT. The two rows have the EXACT SAME FOUR gait phases.
References1 and2 supply character identity/clothes/gear only, NOT their stationary boxing poses. Reference3 exact skin/form comparison. Reference4 eyes. Requiem has sleeved knee-length black coat, Rock has sleeveless studded black vest/skull shirt with bare upper arms. Both have brown parted wavy hair, warm peach skin#F6AE82, clean face, dark RED irises#C40814/#5A0000, black cargo pants, belt and silver hip chain. Both wear same approved dark metal fang GAUNTLETS and matching armored GREAVES. No held weapon. Aura extremely subdued dark carmine at armor, no attack trails.
THIS MUST BE A REAL ALTERNATING WALK, not four tiny variants of one planted leg. Use long enough steps and high enough passing knee that changing support leg is obvious. Visible hip rotation and alternating arm swing, hands relaxed low, no boxing stance. Same scale, same body center and floor baseline, no root translation baked in.
COLUMNS:
1 LEFT-LEG contact: anatomical LEFT leg strides FORWARD and straight, heel leading; anatomical RIGHT leg extends BACK with toe pushing off and heel lifted. Right arm swings forward, left arm back. Knees/boots clearly separated.
2 LEFT-LEG mid-support: LEFT foot planted under hip; RIGHT leg bent at knee passes FORWARD in the air, RIGHT boot lifted and crossing past left shin. LEFT arm forward/right arm back begins counter-swing.
3 RIGHT-LEG contact: anatomical RIGHT leg now strides FORWARD and straight, heel leading; anatomical LEFT leg extends BACK with toe pushing off and heel lifted. LEFT arm swings forward, right arm back. THIS IS THE OPPOSITE LEG CONFIGURATION from column1: clearly swap the thighs, knees, supporting boot and trailing heel. NOT a copy/flat mirror of column1.
4 RIGHT-LEG mid-support: RIGHT foot planted under hip; LEFT bent knee passes FORWARD in air, LEFT boot lifted crossing past right shin. Opposite support and passing leg to column2.
Draw all four entire bodies genuinely, keep silver hip chain on SAME anatomical left hip, don't mirror costume. Crisp deliberate square pixel clusters and stepped dark contours, no smooth painting/blur/realism. 2rows4columns, generous transparent gaps, complete heads/hands/boots/coat inside eachregion. True transparent RGBA, no text/grid/labels/ground/checkerboard/cast shadows. Priority is an unmistakable left-contact -> right-pass -> right-contact -> left-pass cycle.
